memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Moses and Aaron then went into the tent of meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people; and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people." - Lev 9:23 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The promise of verse 4 is kept. The glory of the LORD appeared — and it appeared to all the people.

Not to Moses privately on a mountain. Not to the priests alone inside the tent. To everyone. Farmers, children, the elderly, the ordinary.

God wanted to be seen by all His people.

That has always been His direction. Moses himself once wished it: I wish that all the LORD's people were prophets and that the LORD would put his Spirit on them! (Num 11:29). Centuries later Joel prophesied that God would pour out his Spirit on all people (Joel 2:28) — and Peter announced at Pentecost that the day had come (Acts 2:16-17).

Under the old covenant, access was mediated and restricted. Under the new, the curtain is torn and the Spirit is given to all who believe.

You do not need a spiritual specialist to encounter God on your behalf. Paul says that we all, who with unveiled faces contemplate the Lord's glory, are being transformed into his image (2 Cor 3:18).

All of us. Unveiled faces. That is your inheritance.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I believe God wants to be known by me personally, or only by more spiritual people?
2. Am I actually seeking to see God, or content to hear about Him secondhand?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that Your glory was shown to all Your people, and that in Christ I am among them. Open my eyes to see You. Amen.
